text: Right. I've rung twice tonight and been told someone would get back to me and nobody has, so I'm putting it all in writing. My stepson is 8. His temperature was 37.7 when I checked about half an hour ago. His eczema has flared up really badly over the last day or so, it's the dry itchy patches in the creases of his elbows and on the backs of his knees, and he's been scratching them till they're red and raw-looking in places. His dad is away for work so it's me dealing with it and I don't have his usual cream here, it's at his mum's. His breathing is completely normal before anyone asks, no wheezing, nothing like that, he's chatting away and moaning about being itchy. I just want to know whether I can use something from the chemist overnight or if it has to be the prescribed one, and whether the slight temperature has anything to do with the flare. I'd appreciate an actual answer this time rather than another 'someone will call you'.
